title_as_printed: Comparison between Experimental and Literature Values of CH4 Solubility in Pure Water at 293.2 K
pressure_note: not stated whether total or partial; experimental pressure p, MPa, u(p)=0.01 MPa

value.what: measured CH4 solubility in pure water, printed x 10^3 in mol %

conversion_needs: unit label question: see paper.json quality_remarks
notes: Validation measurement of the apparatus with pure CH4 (99.9 mol %). Temperature printed as 293.2 K in title (293.15 K in Table 3 context not related). The printed unit label 'mol %' with factor 10^3 is judged a mislabel on physical grounds (value x 1e-3 is a mole fraction of the right magnitude for CH4 in water at 293 K, 6-21 MPa; the same label appears in the authors' Figure 7/8 and Table 6); the number is used as a mole fraction x 1e-3, not corrected by a factor 100.
